correctness.rationale: The exact finite component-size partition is exhaustive, with proper treatment of zero or one rim cut. Independent Bernoulli point processes converge jointly to independent finite Poisson point processes; the bounded hub-mass functional is almost surely continuous. The cyclic labeled-word count equals a transfer matrix trace, whose eigenvalues yield the stated full-mass atom. A length-biased cut interval with explicit atom at one yields the exact limiting mean. The standalone checker independently enumerates n=3..7 all edge states and checks the transfer algebra; finite tests are not asserted as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The simultaneous O(1) rim cuts and O(1) spoke links produce a non-self-averaging macroscopic hub component, a natural reliability observable on the canonical hub-plus-cycle network. The explicit zero and full-connection masses and exact finite-to-limit mean describe meaningful boundary reliability, not arbitrary parameter slices. Both mechanisms must be balanced and the mean alone hides the nondegenerate asymptotic distribution.
